name: Jean-Léon Gérôme

summary.text: Jean-Léon Gérôme was a French painter and sculptor in the style now known as academicism. His paintings were so widely reproduced that he was "arguably the world's most famous living artist by 1880."
summary.title: Jean-Léon Gérôme

536395: Slave Market in Ancient Rome is a painting of about 1884 by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, who was known for combining classical, romantic, and realistic elements.
1237863: Pollice Verso is an 1872 painting by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, featuring the eponymous Roman gesture directed to the winning gladiator.
2909909: Bonaparte Before the Sphinx is an 1886 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It is also known as Oedipus (Œdipe).
3211036: The Birth of Venus or Venus Rising (The Star) (French: La Naissance de Vénus; Vénus — l'étoile) is an 1890 painting by Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts the mythological birth of Venus from the sea.
3224275: The Slave Market is an 1866 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts a West Asian or North African setting where a man inspects the teeth of a nude, female Abyssinian slave in the context of the Barbary slave trade.
3503317: The Duel After the Masquerade is a painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, of which multiple copies exist. The original, Suite d'un bal masqué, first shown in 1857, is in the Musée Condé in Chantilly, France.
5665712: Jerusalem is an 1867 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It is also known as Golgotha, Consumatum Est and The Crucifixion.
6543739: Phryne Before the Areopagus is an 1861 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. The painting depicts the trial of Phryne, an ancient Greek hetaira (courtesan), who was charged with impiety.
12899114: Cleopatra and Caesar, also known as Cleopatra Before Caesar, is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French Academic artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, completed in 1866.
17096334: A Roman Slave Market is an 1884 history painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts a slave auction in Ancient Rome.
17275221: La Vérité sortant du puits armée de son martinet pour châtier l'humanité is an 1896 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme.
Truth Coming Out of Her Well
17305020: Tanagra is a polychromic marble sculpture created by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme (1824–1904) as a personification of the "spirit of Tanagra," his own mythic invention tied to the Tanagra figurines from the village of that name in ancient Greece.
17305026: Working in Marble is an 1890 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts Gérôme working in his studio on the sculpture Tangara.
17353200: Reception of the Grand Condé at Versailles, also known as Reception of the Grand Condé by Louis XIV, is a painting by Jean-Léon Gérôme, painted in 1878.
Reception of the Grand Condé at Versailles
17491812: The Cock Fight is an 1846 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It is also known as Young Greeks Attending a Cock Fight.
18393790: The Snake Charmer is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme produced around 1879.
18720658: King Candaules is an 1859 history painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts a legendary scene from the Kingdom of Lydia in Anatolia during classical period.
18748901: The Christian Martyrs' Last Prayer, also known as The Christian Martyrs and The Last Prayer, is an 1883 painting by the French painter Jean-Léon Gérôme. It is part of the collection of the Walters Art Museum in Baltimore.
18748908: The Tulip Folly is an 1882 painting by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. Done in oil on canvas, the painting demonstrates a conceptual scene from the historical "tulip mania" of 17th century Holland.
18749621: The Death of Caesar is an 1867 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts the moment after the assassination of Julius Caesar, when the jubilant conspirators are walking away from Caesar's dead body at the Theatre of Pompey, on the Ides of March, 44 BC.
19861716: Bashi-Bazouk is an oil on canvas painting by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, from 1869. It depicts a Bashi-bazouk, who was an irregular soldier of the Ottoman Empire.
19861886: The Great Bath at Bursa is an 1885 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It features a view inside the bathhouse in the western Turkish city of Bursa then in the Ottoman Empire.
19861888: Moorish Bath is an 1870 Orientalist genre painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts a scene in a Hammam somewhere in the Middle East, featuring a woman likely to be a Circassian and an African attendant.
19861889: Bathsheba is an oil painting on canvas by the French painter Jean-Léon Gérôme, made at Bougival in 1889. The work is now kept in a private collection.
19861910: The Idyll is an 1852 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. Produced in the Neo-Grec style, the art critic Théophile Gautier suggested it as inspired by the novel Daphnis and Chloe from the classical era.
19861917: The End of the Session is an 1886 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It was inspired by his creation of the sculpture Omphale.
19905195: Prayer in the Mosque is an oil on canvas painting by French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, from 1871. It depicts the interior of an Egyptian mosque where worshipers are seen praying.
20540727: Éminence Grise is an 1873 history painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It features a scene from seventeenth century during the reign of Louis XIII.
24965698: The Execution of Marshal Ney is an 1868 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts the French Marshal Michel Ney immediately after his execution on 7 December 1815, with the firing squad seen marching away from the site.
28666504: Pool in a Harem is an 1876 genre painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It features a scene in a bathhouse in the Middle Eastern harem.
29466538: The Two Majesties is an 1883 oil on canvas by the French academic painter Jean-Léon Gérôme, now in the collection of the Milwaukee Art Museum.
50821675: Portrait of Claude-Armand Gérôme is an 1848 portrait painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts his younger brother Claude-Armand in the uniform of a student of the École polytechnique, which specialised in engineering.
85953910: Dance of the Almeh is an 1863 genre painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. It depicts the performance of an Almah belly dancer accompanied by musicians.
88588242: The Draught Players is an 1859 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. A genre painting, it depicts a game of draughts in Cairo.
89373110: Interior of a Mosque is an oil painting on canvas by the French painter Jean-Léon Gérôme, begun in 1890 and finished by 1899. It measures 23 3/8 inches by 35 3/8 inches.
106703268: A Chat by the Fireside is a painting by 19th Century French Orientalist painter Jean-Léon Gérôme. It was completed in 1881 and today is held in the collections of The Spencer Museum of Art at The University of Kansas in Lawrence, Kansas where it is not on public view.
109562503: Pygmalion and Galatea is an 1890 painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. The motif is taken from Ovid's Metamorphoses and depicts the sculptor Pygmalion kissing his statue Galatea at the moment the goddess Aphrodite brings her to life.
110416056: Omphale is a marble sculpture by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme, made between 1886 and 1887, and now kept in the Musée Georges-Garret in Vesoul. A pencil sketch of the work is kept at the Dallas Museum of Art.
132158925: Egyptian Recruits Crossing the Desert is an 1857 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Léon Gérôme. A genre painting of the fashionable Orientalist style, it depicts a group of recruits of the Egyptian Army being escorted through the desert.
